novelty_flags.label: Proposition 1
novelty_flags.one_line: Its eventwise inverse-set inclusions are covered by RenTelschowSchwartzman2024; retain it only as a labelled application corollary, not a novelty-bearing result.

novelty_flags.label: Proposition 3
novelty_flags.one_line: This is explicitly the fixed-preference result of FangRidderXie2026 after restriction to the common subclass, so it is a sanity reduction rather than a new solve target.

soundness_flags.label: Core definition of b_a, K, and all KL-frontier statements
soundness_flags.one_line: The core never requires sum_a b_a(x)=1 almost surely, so b need not be a benchmark probability kernel and K need not be a nonnegative KL divergence; this invalidates the declared range of K and the stated frontier interpretation.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Sections 2--4; Theorem 5 and its displayed limits
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines the benchmark as a probability kernel and Theorem 5 states sqrt(n)(hat theta^dr-theta*) converges to G and n R_lambda(hat theta^dr) converges to one-half G' H G for fixed lambda>0.
The article obtains simultaneous inner and outer confidence sets for inverse sets by inversion of simultaneous confidence intervals, including simultaneous validity across multiple thresholds.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add the primitive benchmark-kernel condition sum_{a in A} b_a(X)=1 almost surely; then K is genuinely KL, pi_0=b, and the divergence coordinate has its stated meaning.
Move the fixed-preference reduction and set inversion to explicitly non-novel sanity/corollary status, and correct the Ren--Telschow--Schwartzman bibliography to JRSSC 73(4):1082--1109, DOI qlae027.

Sharpen the field contribution with a theorem isolating the exact uniform replacement condition that fails for generic fixed-index DML, plus a verifiable sufficient entropy bound for the softmax path; this distinguishes a reusable theorem from a compact-index lifting of FangRidderXie2026.

recommended_next_step: Repair benchmark normalization and demote the two published corollaries from the novelty kernel, then advance the remaining field-grade uniform multiplier question to Stage 0.
